lines.text: Hi, where is my order #1276? I need the bike for my commute next week.

Please cancel my order 1281, I picked the wrong bike. Sorry!
Done: order 1281 is cancelled and $1,183.20 goes back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. You'll get an email confirming it.
My Trail T1 shows E-07 halfway up long climbs. Is something broken?

The E-07 error on your Trail T1 indicates the motor is overheating, usually during long climbs or with heavy loads. Stop and let the motor cool for 10 minutes, then ride in Eco or Tour mode. If the error persists, book a motor check (free under warranty).
Does the Thule Yepp Maxi child seat fit the Commuter C2?
The Thule Yepp Maxi child seat does not fit the Commuter C2. It is only approved for the Cargo X and City S1 rear racks.
Do you sell electric scooters too?
Good question. I've asked a colleague who knows the product well to answer.
This is unacceptable. My bike has been broken for three weeks and nobody answers my emails!
I'm sorry about this. Our team is back at 9:00 AM tomorrow, and your message is first in line. You'll hear from a person then.
Happy to check. What's your order number? It's in your confirmation email.
Your order 1274 is on its way with UPS. Tracking number 1Z0202309442684054.
Can I test ride the Trail T1 somewhere near Oakland?
Yes, you can test ride the Trail T1 at our Oakland showroom located at 1450 Embarcadero, Oakland, Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 to 17:00. Book a time in the chat; we keep the bike ready for you.
